description: Ravel session assistance. Review these hooks normally before use.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import pathlib,runpy,subprocess; p=pathlib.Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],text=True).strip())/'tools/codex/research_session.py'; runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__') if p.is_file() else print('{}')"
